subject.title: Add a Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept `contracts.computerUseProviders` and `computerUseProviderMetadata` as a public metadata-only plugin manifest contract for Computer Use host discovery?
rationale: This is additive, but it freezes new plugin API surface and influences future macOS host decisions around Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions.

options.title: Accept after PR blockers are resolved
options.body: Confirm the metadata remains discovery-only, resolve the linked PR's docs/API review blockers, and land the manifest contract.

options.title: Revise the contract shape first
options.body: Rename or narrow fields, platform metadata, permission metadata, or MCP metadata before making the plugin contract public.

options.title: Pause for host design alignment
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until the macOS host binding model is settled enough to publish the contract.

recommendation.title: Accept after PR blockers are resolved
recommendation.body: Confirm the metadata remains discovery-only, resolve the linked PR's docs/API review blockers, and land the manifest contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across plugin manifest metadata, docs, and adjacent Computer Use setup surfaces.
